svg.title: Weft: two workspaces, one live coordination loop
svg.desc: Two coding agents edit isolated working copies. Each adapter sends symbol changes through a gateway to one repository coordinator. The coordinator orders events and returns a diagnostic to the affected workspace. Animated packets show input, checking and feedback; the static arrows preserve the flow without animation.
